'''0.15b''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that fixed various critical errors.

==Changelog==
* Fixed a critical error during the disconnection from a game server
* Fixed a critical error during the completion of the match, in the presence of set traps
* Fixed a bug related to an overflow in the number of total traps set in a level
